phrases.latin: Baucis ignem excitat et flat, dōnec ex fūmō flamma oritur
phrases.english: Baucis stirs up the fire and blows until a flame rises from the smoke

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word.
